sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "semesters" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "semester_number" INTEGER NOT NULL, "academic_year" TEXT NOT NULL, "start_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, CHECK (length(trim(name)) > 0), CHECK (semester_number > 0), CHECK (length(trim(academic_year)) > 0), CHECK (end_date >= start_date));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "subjects" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "semester_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES semesters (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "short_code" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "professor" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "room" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "attendance_target" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.75, "display_color" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_archived" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, UNIQUE (id, semester_id), CHECK (length(trim(name)) > 0), CHECK (attendance_target > 0 AND attendance_target <= 1), CHECK (display_color >= 0 AND display_color <= 4294967295));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "timetable_entries" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "semester_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES semesters (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "subject_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "weekday" INTEGER NOT NULL, "start_time" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_time" INTEGER NOT NULL, "room" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "note" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "effective_from" INTEGER NULL, "effective_until" INTEGER NULL, FOREIGN KEY (subject_id, semester_id) REFERENCES subjects (id, semester_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, CHECK (weekday BETWEEN 1 AND 7), CHECK (start_time BETWEEN 0 AND 1439), CHECK (end_time BETWEEN 1 AND 1440), CHECK (end_time > start_time), CHECK (effective_until IS NULL OR effective_from IS NULL OR effective_until >= effective_from));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "attendance_sessions" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "subject_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES subjects (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "period" INTEGER NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, CHECK (period > 0), CHECK (status IN ('present', 'absent', 'cancelled')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "daily_attendance_records" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "date" INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, CHECK (status IN ('present', 'absent')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "scheduled_class_attendance" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "semester_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES semesters (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "timetable_entry_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES timetable_entries (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "subject_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES subjects (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "start_time" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_time" INTEGER NOT NULL, "attendance_status" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "manually_modified" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("manually_modified" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, CHECK (start_time BETWEEN 0 AND 1439), CHECK (end_time BETWEEN 1 AND 1440), CHECK (end_time > start_time), CHECK (attendance_status IN ('unmarked', 'present', 'absent', 'cancelled')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "calendar_day_overrides" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "semester_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES semesters (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, CHECK (type IN ('normal', 'holiday', 'collegeClosed')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tasks" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "semester_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES semesters (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "subject_id" INTEGER NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "priority" TEXT NOT NULL, "due_date" INTEGER NULL, "due_time" INTEGER NULL, "reminder_at" INTEGER NULL, "is_completed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_completed" IN (0, 1)), "completed_at" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY (subject_id, semester_id) REFERENCES subjects (id, semester_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, CHECK (length(trim(title)) > 0), CHECK (type IN ('general', 'assignment', 'study')), CHECK (priority IN ('low', 'medium', 'high')), CHECK (due_time IS NULL OR due_time BETWEEN 0 AND 1439), CHECK (due_time IS NULL OR due_date IS NOT NULL), CHECK ((is_completed = 0 AND completed_at IS NULL) OR (is_completed = 1 AND completed_at IS NOT NULL)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "exams" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "semester_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES semesters (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "subject_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "exam_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "exam_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "start_time" INTEGER NULL, "end_time" INTEGER NULL, "room" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "syllabus" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "max_marks" REAL NULL, "obtained_marks" REAL NULL, "reminder_at" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, UNIQUE (id, subject_id), FOREIGN KEY (subject_id, semester_id) REFERENCES subjects (id, semester_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, CHECK (length(trim(name)) > 0), CHECK (length(trim(exam_type)) > 0), CHECK (start_time IS NULL OR start_time BETWEEN 0 AND 1439), CHECK (end_time IS NULL OR end_time BETWEEN 1 AND 1440), CHECK (start_time IS NULL OR end_time IS NULL OR end_time > start_time), CHECK (max_marks IS NULL OR max_marks > 0), CHECK (obtained_marks IS NULL OR obtained_marks >= 0), CHECK (obtained_marks IS NULL OR max_marks IS NULL OR obtained_marks <= max_marks));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "marks" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "subject_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES subjects (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "exam_id" INTEGER NULL, "category" TEXT NOT NULL, "obtained_marks" REAL NOT NULL, "max_marks" REAL NOT NULL, "date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', FOREIGN KEY (exam_id, subject_id) REFERENCES exams (id, subject_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, CHECK (length(trim(category)) > 0), CHECK (max_marks > 0), CHECK (obtained_marks >= 0 AND obtained_marks <= max_marks));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_settings" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "college_name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "course" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "branch" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "academic_year_start_date" INTEGER NULL, "academic_year_end_date" INTEGER NULL, "default_attendance_target" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.75, "theme_mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'system', "onboarding_completed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("onboarding_completed" IN (0, 1)), "notifications_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("notifications_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "automatic_local_backup" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("automatic_local_backup" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (id = 1), CHECK (default_attendance_target > 0 AND default_attendance_target <= 1), CHECK (theme_mode IN ('system', 'light', 'dark')));
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX semesters_one_active ON semesters (is_active) WHERE is_active = 1
CREATE INDEX semesters_academic_year_number ON semesters (academic_year, semester_number)
CREATE INDEX subjects_semester_archived_name ON subjects (semester_id, is_archived, name)
CREATE INDEX timetable_semester_weekday_start ON timetable_entries (semester_id, weekday, start_time)
CREATE INDEX timetable_subject ON timetable_entries (subject_id)
CREATE INDEX attendance_subject_date_period ON attendance_sessions (subject_id, date, period)
CREATE INDEX attendance_subject_status ON attendance_sessions (subject_id, status)
CREATE INDEX daily_attendance_status ON daily_attendance_records (status)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX scheduled_attendance_date_timetable ON scheduled_class_attendance (date, timetable_entry_id)
CREATE INDEX scheduled_attendance_subject_date ON scheduled_class_attendance (subject_id, date)
CREATE INDEX scheduled_attendance_semester_date ON scheduled_class_attendance (semester_id, date)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX calendar_override_semester_date ON calendar_day_overrides (semester_id, date)
CREATE INDEX tasks_semester_completed_due ON tasks (semester_id, is_completed, due_date)
CREATE INDEX tasks_subject_completed ON tasks (subject_id, is_completed)
CREATE INDEX exams_semester_date_start ON exams (semester_id, exam_date, start_time)
CREATE INDEX exams_subject_date ON exams (subject_id, exam_date)
CREATE INDEX marks_subject_date ON marks (subject_id, date)
CREATE INDEX marks_exam ON marks (exam_id)
